commands_run: clan patch-data test-sandbox/happy/lite/h1-clan/work/doc.clan '{...full risks array...}' --agent hop-02-risk-add --action 'Add vendor lock-in risk'
clan patch-html test-sandbox/happy/lite/h1-clan/work/doc.clan - --selector '#risk-rows' --patch-action append --agent hop-02-risk-add --action 'Add vendor lock-in risk row'

errors.recovered_by: Used --agent and --action flags per clan patch-data --help

problems_and_friction: patch-data does not accept --attribution; the correct flags are --agent and --action, discovered via --help. Otherwise the guided arm worked cleanly: read current array, appended entry, patched data then HTML, validated OK.
context_understood: Risks is an array so patch-data must receive the full replacement array; the HTML table row is appended literally to #risk-rows via patch-html.
